solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sign up ace goal maker, an ex-England player

indicators.note: a maker produces something new, so these thirteen letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A footballer is told to sign up the man who makes goals, a former England international.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maker' looks like part of 'goal maker', but it signals rearranging SIGN UP ACE GOAL. Paul Gascoigne, 'Gazza', was a celebrated England midfielder of the late 1980s and 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul Gascoigne is an example of a footballer who formerly played for England's national side.

clue.text: Maintains a rising pressure

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: stress is pressure or strain

explanation.surface: Someone keeps up a steadily increasing pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain a claim is to state it firmly, a synonym for declaring it true.

clue.text: Head's bloomer, perhaps

definitions.meaning: 'Head is': in British slang the head is a ..., as in 'use your ...'
a bloomer is a British style of crusty bread

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a headteacher's blunder; 'bloomer' means a mistake too, but here it is the bread. 'Use your loaf' is rhyming slang (loaf of bread = head).
explanation.definitionFit: Slang uses the bread word for the head, and a bloomer is one kind of baked bread.

clue.text: Mean to declare a woman's secret

parts.note: to aver is to declare or assert
a woman's age is traditionally the thing she keeps secret

explanation.surface: Someone means to reveal a lady's closely guarded secret.
explanation.definitionFit: An average is the arithmetic mean, so the nouns are synonyms in statistics.

clue.text: Town-crier's profession?

parts.note: a town crier's job is to call out news, and a profession or vocation is also a word for the same thing

explanation.definitionFit: A calling is a vocation or profession, and calling out is literally what a town crier does.

clue.text: Nothing in it, a mere tittle

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the word it, so in signals a container

parts.note: taken as written
nothing is zero, written as the letter O

explanation.surface: Something with nothing in it is just a tiny scrap.
explanation.definitionFit: A tittle is a tiny dot or jot; the Greek letter word here also means a minute amount.

clue.text: Gear in a new Renault

indicators.note: new means the letters of the car's name are given a new order

explanation.surface: A car is described as being in a certain gear.
explanation.walkthrough: The car brand looks like part of the scene; its letters are the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Neutral is the gear position in which no drive is engaged.

clue.text: Cases of eviction?

parts.note: cases can be legal cases or suitcases; someone thrown out leaves with all their luggage

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means completely, with all belongings, as when a tenant is turned out of a home.

clue.text: An almost negligible amount, like one in ten

definitions.meaning: a tiny quantity, hardly anything at all
in the numeral 10 the digit one stands beside the zero

explanation.walkthrough: 'one in ten' looks like a proportion, but it is the written number 10, where 1 sits beside 0.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a trivially small amount, and literally describes the 1 beside the 0 in 10.

clue.text: Still a variety of sausage

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: A distillery or butcher offers a new kind of sausage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Still' is a verb here, to calm or soothe.
explanation.definitionFit: To still pain or fear is to soothe or ease it, a synonym.

clue.text: Leaves to dress for dinner

parts.note: the leaves are salad greens and dressing them means adding salad dressing, not putting on smart clothes

explanation.definitionFit: Salad greens are leaves that are tossed in a dressing before being served at a meal.

clue.text: Israeli port area

definitions.meaning: a historic harbour city in northern Israel near Haifa
a unit of land area equal to 4,840 square yards

explanation.definitionFit: The name is both an old Israeli harbour town and an imperial measure of land.

clue.text: Swift and quiet in attack

indicators.note: the quiet letter is placed inside the word for attack

parts.note: a raid is a sudden attack
p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet

explanation.surface: A soldier praises a fast, silent assault.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapid means swift or fast, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Once put down, it can be served

definitions.meaning: an archaic past form of write, meaning written down in former times
a legal document such as a summons is served on someone

explanation.definitionFit: The word is an old past participle of write and also a court order that is served.

clue.text: By the sound of it, gather a crowd

indicators.note: signals that the word heard aloud is spelt differently in the grid

parts.note: to hoard is to gather and store things up

explanation.surface: Apparently someone is collecting a crowd of people.
explanation.definitionFit: A horde is a large crowd or throng of people.

clue.text: Such panic may be started by fire or burglary

definitions.text: Such panic may be started by fire or burglary

parts.words: Such panic may be started by fire or burglary
parts.note: panic means fear, but the clue also points to the warning devices set off by fire or intruders

explanation.definitionFit: The word means sudden fear and also the warning signal set off by smoke or a break-in.

clue.text: Arrange to get rid

definitions.meaning: to set out or place in order

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to place in order and, with 'of', to throw away.

clue.text: Girl I sign on as a star-gazer

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
Leo is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A girl puts her name down to join up as an astronomer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sign on' suggests enrolling; here 'sign' is a zodiac sign and 'on' just joins it.
explanation.definitionFit: Galileo was the Italian astronomer who studied the heavens through a telescope.

clue.text: Carried on organising coup d'etat but having to drop out

indicators.note: organising means putting the letters into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Rebels kept going with plans for a putsch, though they had to withdraw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having to drop out' looks like the plotters withdrawing; it tells you which word's letters leave the fodder before 'organising' reshuffles what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: To act up is to misbehave, the same as carrying on in the informal sense.

clue.text: A unit is ordered to somewhere in N Africa

indicators.note: ordered means arranged afresh, so the letters are shuffled into a new sequence

explanation.surface: A military unit is commanded to go to a North African location.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a country on the North African coast, an example of a place there.

clue.text: Dog lead?

definitions.meaning: a breed of gun dog that indicates where game is
a lead in the sense of a hint or tip that points the way

explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' looks like a dog's leash; it is a clue or hint.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a hunting dog breed and also a helpful hint.

clue.text: Strong wind wrenched a door half off

parts.note: torn means wrenched or pulled apart

indicators.note: half of the word door is kept and the rest taken off

explanation.surface: A gale tore away a door.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent whirling storm, an extreme kind of strong wind.

clue.text: Date and remove

definitions.meaning: to take someone out on a date
to take something out is to remove it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to escort someone on an outing and also to extract something.

clue.text: A service for car and plane-travellers

definitions.text: A service for car and plane-travellers

parts.words: A service for car and plane-travellers
parts.note: for drivers it is the compressed hose at a garage for tyres; for flyers it is a company running flights

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is a garage tyre hose; as one it is a company that flies passengers.

clue.text: They're drunk and sing wildly

indicators.note: wildly means the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Revellers who have had too much sing with abandon.
explanation.definitionFit: These spirits are drinks, things that are drunk.

clue.text: Minor injuries — in fact they sound nothing

indicators.note: signals that the answer is said the same as another word

parts.note: nix is slang for nothing

explanation.surface: Small cuts, it turns out, really amount to nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicks are small cuts, minor injuries to the skin.

clue.text: Cunning means of support

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means sly or knowing
a curved structure that holds up a bridge or roof

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means roguish or sly; the noun is a curved load-bearing structure.

clue.text: Two officers, one gun

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer
Lt is short for lieutenant

explanation.surface: A pair of officers has only one weapon between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A Colt is a make of revolver, an example of a gun.

clue.text: Turn up gas-ring to cook it

definitions.text: Turn up gas-ring to cook it

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: Instructions to raise the heat on the hob to cook something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn up' seems to mean raising the flame. The whole clue doubles as the definition: 'it' is the milk pudding grain you cook on a gas ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Sago is a starchy grain that is boiled on the hob, the thing cooked in the clue's picture.

clue.text: Have fun on leave near Portsmouth

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after the other piece

parts.note: to go is to leave
to sport is to play or have fun

explanation.surface: A sailor enjoys himself while on shore leave.
explanation.walkthrough: Gosport is a naval town across the harbour from Portsmouth on England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition names the town by location: it lies just across the harbour from that city.

clue.text: Eggs turn into cheers

parts.note: ova is the Latin plural for eggs

indicators.note: turn means the letters are turned around into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone's eggs turn into something to applaud.
explanation.definitionFit: An ovation is a round of applause, the same as a crowd's cheers.

clue.text: Coups cause teacher to have moments of apoplexy

parts.note: a schoolmaster is a teacher
a stroke is an attack of apoplexy

explanation.surface: Clever triumphs give the schoolmaster fits of rage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'apoplexy' suggests rage, but here it is the old medical term for a stroke.
explanation.definitionFit: A coup in its sense of a brilliant success is a masterly move, a synonym.
